decision_checklist.summary: Keep grace-period start, publication, and per-node propagation in C while the survey records the sequencing boundary.
decision_checklist.rationale: The grace-period core still couples gp_seq advancement to the rcu_node hierarchy, qsmask state, and memory-ordering guarantees, so Phase 14 should record the boundary rather than claim a wrapper around tree.c.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep the lock-ordering network and grace-period publication stores in C while the survey records the memory-ordering boundary.
decision_checklist.rationale: Tree RCU still relies on the documented rcu_node lock network, GP publication stores, and polling-order semantics, so this lock network remains a live core ordering contract rather than a detachable bridge seam.

decision_checklist.summary: Treat expedited grace-period selection, waiting, and sequence completion as explicit stay-in-C boundaries.
decision_checklist.rationale: The expedited path still funnels CPU selection, IPI-driven quiescent-state forcing, timeout or stall handling, and sequence serialization through tightly coupled tree_exp.h logic that should remain in C.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep NOCB bypass locking and deferred wakeups in C while the survey records the callback-offload boundary.
decision_checklist.rationale: The NOCB path still relies on bypass-list pressure, kthread wakeup policy, and deferred GP wakeups across tree.c and tree_nocb.h, so Zigux should mark the boundary without inventing ownership over callback offload.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep idle-watch re-entry, dyntick snapshot ordering, and core invocation in C while the survey records the live watching boundary.
decision_checklist.rationale: Extended-quiescent-state detection still depends on per-CPU watching state, remote dyntick ordering, and the live choice between softirq and rcuc wakeups, so this dyntick boundary remains coupled to live Tree RCU state.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep quiescent-state propagation, per-node GP updates, and callback acceleration in C while the survey records how these paths stay coupled.
decision_checklist.rationale: Quiescent-state reporting still climbs the rcu_node hierarchy under lock, `note_gp_changes()` still folds gp-sequence changes into per-CPU callback state, and callback acceleration still depends on segmented callback lists and offload state, so this seam remains study-only.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep callback enqueue, grace-period kick decisions, and batch invocation in C while the survey records the coupled callback lifecycle.
decision_checklist.rationale: Callback enqueue still routes through per-CPU segmented callback lists, overload tracking, NOCB offload selection, grace-period forcing, and time-bounded batch execution, so this seam is still coupled to live Tree RCU state rather than a narrow wrapper contract.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep CPU hotplug enrollment, teardown, and callback migration in C while the survey records the callback-migration boundary.
decision_checklist.rationale: CPU hotplug still couples rcutree_prepare_cpu() enrollment, rcutree_offline_cpu() teardown, and callback migration to the live rcu_data and rcu_node hierarchy, so this path remains blocked on stay-in-C evidence instead of being a detachable tree_bridge wrapper seam.
